name: Computational Deformation Field (CDF)
definition: A storage-efficient deformation field that synthesizes spatial features on-the-fly using a neural decoder instead of retrieving them from large learnable multi-resolution hash tables, reducing memory footprint for dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting.
summary: Computational Deformation Field is a storage-efficient method for dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces large hash tables with a neural decoder to synthesize spatial features on-the-fly.
